recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-close-up portrait of a woman with a 1970s feathered bob haircut, wearing a red-and-white gingham shirt, set against a stark black background. The composition is topped by bold, stacked typography featuring high-contrast serifs and decorative swashes.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast relationship between the subject's warm skin tones and the deep black negative space.
Geometric repetition of the gingham pattern against the organic curves of the hair and face.
Typographic hierarchy where the artist's name acts as a bridge between the title and the subject's head.
coreInvariants: Stark black background with no environmental detail.
Warm, diffused studio lighting creating soft shadows on the face.
Red and white checkered pattern on the garment.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame, with hands resting at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large, stylized artist name above the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top title, moves down to the stylized name, then rests on the subject's face and hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space flanking the head and shoulders, focusing all attention on the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm peach and copper tones (skin and hair) against the black.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and white (gingham shirt) and orange-gold (outlined typography).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, warm saturation typical of 1970s film stock; high value contrast between the white checks and the black void.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to earth tones, red, white, and black

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast serif and heavy grotesque sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Top title uses a tightly tracked, bold, condensed sans-serif.
Main name uses a high-contrast serif with pronounced ball terminals and decorative swashes on 'V', 'K', 'L', and 'R'.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on capital letters that tuck under or over adjacent characters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A condensed, blocky sans-serif for the album title paired with a flamboyant, swash-heavy serif for the artist name.

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the iconic 70s decorative serif look with ball terminals.
Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the top-most title text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with 1970s feathered copper-brown hair, wearing a red and white gingham shirt, hands resting on a surface in front of her, centered against a solid black background. Soft, warm 70s film lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a condensed bold sans-serif title at the very top edge. Below it, add the artist's name in a large, orange-gold decorative serif font with swashes and a thin white outline. Add tracklist columns in small white sans-serif to the left and right of the head.

verificationChecks: Does the hair have the characteristic 70s 'feathered' volume?
Is the main text using a swash-heavy serif?
Is the gingham pattern red and white?

adjustableVariables: Gingham color (e.g., blue/white instead of red/white)
Specific swash intensity on the display type
mustRedesign: Any modern digital artifacts or sharp high-frequency noise

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and color temperature

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the face.
Check that the gingham pattern scale is appropriate for the shirt.
Verify the 'glow' or softness of the skin tones matches 70s photography.
Confirm the black background is deep and uniform.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a centered 70s-style portrait against black, add a condensed sans-serif header, and bridge the gap with a large, swash-heavy decorative serif nameplate in a warm accent color.
